description:
Fair Deal Property, Your trusted Experts for Residential Property Sales,

Are delighted to present Number 70 Toberjarlath Road to the market.

Toberjarlath is one of Tuam’s oldest and most endearing neighbourhoods, a well-established community renowned for its wonderful sense of community spirit, which stretches back generations. Number 70 occupies a highly convenient position close to the junction with the Athenry Road and within walking distance of Tuam town centre.

This impressive three-bedroom family residence has been extensively upgraded and extended in recent years. The widened entrance provides off-street parking for up to three cars, while an attractive decorative-pebble finish continues around the property towards the spacious rear garden.

The home makes an immediate impression on arrival, with an energy-efficient composite entrance door sheltered by an attractive overhanging porch.

A substantial rear extension has created a bright, contemporary open-plan kitchen, dining and lounge area. The kitchen features an abundance of modern fitted units with marble counter tops. Velux roof windows flood the room with natural light, while double-glazed patio doors overlook and provide direct access to the generous rear garden.

To the front of the property is a versatile ground-floor bedroom, which could also serve as a second living room, playroom or home office. A conveniently located guest WC completes the ground-floor accommodation.

Upstairs, there are two spacious and light-filled double bedrooms together with a stylishly upgraded family bathroom.

The property has undergone a significant energy upgrade and benefits from a C-rated BER. It is also coming to the market with a newly fitted, highly efficient oil boiler, along with upgraded fixtures and fittings throughout.

In a nutshell, Number 70 is a wonderfully presented, extensively upgraded and extended family home offering generous outdoor space, ample off-street parking and outstanding value for money in one of Tuam’s best-loved neighbourhoods. It is ideally located within walking distance of the town centre and approximately 30 minutes from the heart of Galway City.

If you are searching for an excellent-value, fully extended and wonderfully located three- bedroom family residence in the heart of Tuam, we suggest that you look no further than Number 70 Toberjarlath Road as it is certain to meet all your requirements.

If this sounds like the home for you, we would be delighted to hear from you and assist in any
way we can.

Brought to you by Fair Deal Property, your trusted experts for residential property sales.
